text:
sarah: Heads-up — seeing jittery handoffs from HubSpot RR into Salesforce. A few leads got assigned to the same rep within ~5m, and enrichment delays seem to cause claim skips. Rolling numbers now, pinging ops/salesops.

jake: Seen this in staging earlier. `lead_assigner` logs show repeated retries when webhook returns 5xx, and RR slot locking isn't honoring debounce.

priya: Can you drop a sample lead id + logs? We had an enrichment case where HS returned 202 then 504 and it retried into RR.

sarah: sample lead: 0xB9C1. Logs snippet:
```
POST /assign -> 500
retry=1
slot=42
claimed_by=null
```

tom: Sounds like we need a soft-tombstone per lead + jitter on RR selection. If enrichment is in-flight and a retry comes, tombstone prevents immediate reassign. Also increase enrichment backoff to 60s.

jake: I can implement `tombstone:{lead_id}` in Redis with a 30s TTL and add a 5-15s jitter to rr algorithm. Will run a canary.

priya: If we add tombstones, we should update handoff SLA language — claim window will effectively increase. Propose updating SLA from 20s -> 45s for claim window and note why. Sales ops ok with that?

jake: Agree on SLA update. Plan: deploy tombstone + jitter to 10% prod traffic as a canary, measure duplicates and claim latency. I can push a PR today.

sarah: :thumbsup: schedule canary in morning to avoid APAC peak.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started for service=lead-assigner env=prod pct=10

tom: I'll add observability: histogram for `claim_latency`, gauge for `tombstone_hits`, and alert if duplicates > 0.5% in 5m. Ping me if numbers spike.

priya: I'll update the handoff playbook and the HubSpot->SF mapping notes: add a troubleshooting bullet for `tombstone` keys and `enrichment_backoff`.

sarah: Follow-ups: jake -> PR for tombstone/jitter, tom -> dashboards/alerts, priya -> playbook + SLA blurb. Sync after canary at 11:30am.

jake: On it — will post PR link here when ready.

sarah: Thanks team.
